title: Your First Weekend at Calvin University, Shared as Cards
description: A low-key first-weekend loop through ten documented Calvin destinations, balancing food, campus orientation, study, art, nature, recreation, and a weather-dependent night-sky option.

cards.title: Start with a Commons meal
cards.subtitle: Arrival meal · Commons Building
cards.notes: Use a meal to regroup after move-in, then ask dining staff or check the dining update page before returning for weekend service.
cards.short_summary: A practical opening stop for food and campus bearings.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin lists Commons Dining Hall weekend hours as 9 a.m.–7 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Weekend service is listed as Saturday and Sunday, 9 a.m.–7 p.m.; confirm any holiday or break changes with Dining Services.

cards.title: Get your bearings on Commons Lawn
cards.subtitle: Campus gathering space · beside Commons Annex
cards.notes: Pause here with your campus map, pick two nearby buildings to recognize, and watch for university-posted activities rather than assuming an event is running.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor reference point for orienting yourself near the Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin’s current intramural information lists Commons Lawn as the location for its Spikeball League.
cards.access_notes: Treat this as an outdoor campus stop; participation and event access depend on the particular posted program.

cards.title: Choose a study perch at Hekman
cards.subtitle: 1855 Knollcrest Circle SE
cards.notes: Walk the floors, note the research-help options, and save the library’s hours page before making it your next study stop.
cards.short_summary: A campus library stop with study areas and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Hekman Library reports 1,037 study spaces and directs visitors to its open-hours information.
cards.access_notes: The official place page links to current open hours; access to services and collections may vary by visitor status.

cards.title: Check the exhibition at Center Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Covenant Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Look up the current exhibition before walking over, then give yourself time to view the work without building the plan around a specific show.
cards.short_summary: A rotating-exhibition pause in the fine arts center.
cards.evidence_claim: Center Art Gallery presents temporary exhibitions including loan shows and work by visiting artists, faculty, alumni, and students.
cards.access_notes: The gallery welcomes visitors throughout the academic year; check its hours-and-location information for the current schedule.

cards.title: See the mineral cases at Dice Museum
cards.subtitle: North Hall 125 · Science Building
cards.notes: Confirm that school is in session, then enter North Hall and follow the museum’s walking directions to room 162 for a self-guided look.
cards.short_summary: A compact geology collection with student-docent tours during open hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum says informal tours by student docents are offered during open hours and visitors may also explore the collection on their own.
cards.source_title: Visit Us | Bruce Dice Mineralogical Museum
cards.access_notes: Open when school is in session during fall and spring semesters; the official page gives parking and indoor walking directions.

cards.title: Try an open-climb session
cards.subtitle: Spoelhof Fieldhouse Complex lobby
cards.notes: Complete the required waiver and attend a first-timer training session if needed; use the posted session schedule before heading to the wall.
cards.short_summary: A staff-supported climbing option for Calvin students.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin states that the Climbing Center provides free climbing experiences for Calvin students, faculty, and staff, with first-timer training at sessions.
cards.access_notes: Not open to the general public. The page lists Saturday open climbing 12–4 p.m. and Sunday 2–4 p.m. during fall and spring terms, subject to listed closures.

cards.title: Take a native-garden lap
cards.subtitle: Calvin Ecosystem Preserve & Native Gardens
cards.notes: Use the garden map and QR codes on site to identify one habitat-style planting, then continue only on marked public paths.
cards.short_summary: A map-supported native-plant stop beside the preserve.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin identifies Venema Plaza & Gardens as public native gardens with QR codes linking visitors to garden descriptions and plant lists.
cards.access_notes: Use the official garden map and respect posted site guidance; outdoor conditions and programming vary.

cards.title: Walk the preserve trails
cards.subtitle: 44 public acres · East Campus
cards.notes: Download the trail guide, stay on marked paths, and plan to leave before dusk; do not enter water or restricted wildlife-refuge areas.
cards.short_summary: A daylight walk through Calvin’s publicly accessible forest and wetlands.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin says the preserve has 44 acres of forest and wetlands accessible to the public, with more than a mile of trails.
cards.access_notes: Walking trails are open 7 a.m. to dusk. Hiking only; guests must stay on trails and out of water bodies.

cards.title: Save Chapel for the next campus rhythm
cards.subtitle: 1835 Knollcrest Circle SE
cards.notes: Add the chapel schedule to your calendar for the coming week, then use the accessible entrance and parking information if you plan to attend.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled worship stop to bookmark after the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin offers chapel services in the University Chapel on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 10:30–10:50 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists accessible parking in Lot 12, automatic-door entrances, barrier-free restrooms, and an elevator.

cards.title: End with a clear-sky observatory check
cards.subtitle: Science Building roof
cards.notes: Check the sky and call the dome before walking over; if an observer answers, follow the stated entrance route from Commons Lawn.
cards.short_summary: A weather-dependent evening telescope option on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin’s observatory page says it is open on clear Monday–Wednesday nights during the school semester and gives evening hours.
cards.access_notes: Open only on clear nights. During the school semester, the page lists 7:30–11 p.m. in standard time or 30 minutes after sunset–11 p.m. after daylight saving; call 616-526-6435 to confirm.
